sections.heading: Two tenses, two jobs
sections.body:
In a story about the past, French uses both tenses together:

- **passé composé** — the **events**: what happened, one after another, completed. It moves the story forward. *Je suis sorti. J'ai pris le bus. Je suis arrivé au bureau.*
- **imparfait** — the **background**: the scene, descriptions, feelings, what was going on. It doesn't move the story forward. *Il pleuvait. Il y avait beaucoup de monde. J'étais en retard.*

Put together: *Il pleuvait et j'étais en retard. J'ai pris un taxi.* (It was raining and I was late. I took a taxi.)

sections.heading: Interrupted actions
sections.body:
An action **in progress** (imparfait) is interrupted by a **sudden event** (passé composé):

- *Je dormais quand le téléphone a sonné.* — I was sleeping when the phone rang.
- *Nous dînions quand Hugo est arrivé.* — We were having dinner when Hugo arrived.

sections.heading: Signal words
sections.body:
- With the passé composé: *hier*, *un jour*, *soudain* (suddenly), *tout à coup* (all of a sudden), *ensuite*, *une fois* (once), *pendant deux heures* (for a closed period).
- With the imparfait: *d'habitude*, *tous les jours*, *souvent*, *toujours*, *autrefois*, *quand j'étais petit*, *pendant que* (while).

Compare: *Hier, j'ai joué au tennis.* (Yesterday I played tennis — one event.) *Le samedi, je jouais au tennis.* (On Saturdays I used to play tennis — a habit.)

sections.heading: Pronunciation: j'ai parlé or je parlais?
sections.body: The two tenses can sound very close: *j'ai parlé* /ʒe paʁ.le/ ends in a closed [e]; *je parlais* /ʒə paʁ.lɛ/ ends in an open [ɛ]. Listen also for the start: *j'ai* /ʒe/ vs *je* /ʒə/. In careful speech, keep [e] and [ɛ] apart: *j'ai mangé* — *je mangeais*; *il a chanté* — *il chantait*.

examples: Il pleuvait et j'étais en retard, alors j'ai pris un taxi.
It was raining and I was late, so I took a taxi.
Je dormais quand le téléphone a sonné.
I was sleeping when the phone rang.
Nous dînions quand Hugo est arrivé.
We were having dinner when Hugo arrived.
Il faisait beau, alors nous sommes allés à la plage.
The weather was nice, so we went to the beach.
Soudain, j'ai entendu un bruit.
Suddenly I heard a noise.
Pendant que je travaillais, les enfants jouaient.
While I was working, the children were playing.
Hier, j'ai joué au tennis pendant deux heures.
Yesterday I played tennis for two hours.
Le samedi, je jouais au tennis avec mon père.
On Saturdays I used to play tennis with my father.
Elle était fatiguée, mais elle a fini son travail.
She was tired, but she finished her work.
Tout à coup, la lumière s'est éteinte.
All of a sudden, the light went out.
Quand je suis arrivée, il y avait beaucoup de monde.
When I arrived, there were a lot of people.
J'ai parlé à Léa, elle parlait de ses vacances.
I spoke to Léa; she was talking about her holiday.
